description: Manual real-user regression cases from the targeted quality pass. Expectations are behavioral, not exact wording.

cases.query: The seller is refusing to refund a defective product.
cases.notes: Ordinary refund/remedy framing should outrank product-liability framing.

cases.query: My landlord in Delhi has disconnected the electricity supply to my rented house. What can I do?
Someone used my personal details to access my online account without permission. What can I do?
cases.notes: Natural credential misuse should surface Section 66C.

cases.query: Someone used my password and personal details to log into my account without my permission. Is this identity theft under Indian cyber law?
My landlord in Mumbai has disconnected the electricity supply to my rented house. What can I do?
I filed an RTI application but did not receive any reply. What can I do next?
Can the government treat two similarly situated citizens differently without a valid reason? Does Article 14 apply?
I bought a phone online for Rs. 20000. It was defective from the first day. I asked the seller for a refund, but they refused. I have the invoice and chat messages. What can I do?
I paid Rs. 15000 to an Instagram seller for a phone, but after receiving the payment they blocked me and never delivered the product. What can I do?
I cannot afford a lawyer. Am I eligible for free legal aid and where can I apply?
My landlord is threatening me. What can I do?
My wife has filed for divorce. What legal options do I have?
I bought a defective laptop online. It stopped working within two days, but the seller is refusing replacement or refund. No one was injured. What can I do?
cases.notes: Explicit no-harm facts should suppress product-liability framing.

cases.query: I paid Rs. 15000 to an Instagram seller for a phone, but after receiving the payment they blocked me and never delivered the product. What can I do?
cases.notes: Consumer remedy and cyber reporting sources should both survive.

cases.query: I filed an RTI application but did not receive any reply. What can I do next?
cases.notes: Section 19 appeal material should be the primary RTI non-response route, with complaint/penalty material secondary.
